artificial.en: They've been around for decades, and despite what the fear mongering might have you believe, most of what they do has nothing to do with artificial intelligence.
artificial.zh: 它们已经存在了几十年，尽管某些耸人听闻的言论可能会让你胡思乱想，但它们的大部分工作与人工智能毫无关系。

argue.en: Potatoes originated in South America. But nobody seriously argues that fish and chips isn’t British.
argue.zh: 土豆起源于南美洲。但没有人严肃地争辩说炸鱼薯条不是英国的。
